components.name: Document Capture
components.evidence: Deterministic quality gate (blur, glare, brightness, shadow, coverage, perspective, resolution, multiple documents); 6 real KH ID photos: 2 accepted, 4 sent to recapture with correct instructions.
components.blocker: Quality thresholds not calibrated on real phone captures.
components.next_action: Collect 200+ real captures per document across Android and iPhone; set thresholds from measured OCR success.
limitations: No live best-frame selection for document capture; the first accepted upload is processed.

components.name: KH National ID
components.evidence: Adapter KH-NID-ADAPTER-2026.10.3; front MRZ (TD1) parsing; on 2 usable real cards the MRZ failed check digits or was not found, so both went to recapture/review (fail-safe).
components.blocker: Real-card extraction rate unmeasured.
components.next_action: Build a labelled set of 200 consented KH ID captures and measure field accuracy.

components.name: KH NSSF
components.evidence: Adapter on the shared Khmer label engine; synthetic fixtures only.
components.blocker: No measured extraction on real NSSF cards.
components.next_action: Collect 100 consented NSSF captures; confirm whether the last number digit is a check digit.

components.name: KH Passport
components.evidence: Visual fields + TD3 MRZ engine; synthetic specimens only.
components.blocker: No real passport tested.
components.next_action: Test 30+ real Cambodian passports (data page) with consent.

components.name: OCR (Latin)
components.evidence: Tesseract 5 full-image OCR with a constrained numeric re-read.
components.blocker: No CER/WER benchmark.
components.next_action: Run scripts on a labelled set; report CER/WER per field and per capture condition.

components.name: Khmer OCR
components.evidence: Full-page khm+eng OCR plus a Khmer-digit re-read. On 2 usable real KH IDs the Khmer name read at confidence 0.37-0.38 and sex, address and issue date were not found. Fixed: the Khmer digit model was silently skipped in the container image (Debian names it Khmer, not script/Khmer).
components.blocker: No per-field ROI cropping, multi-variant preprocessing or voting; Khmer name/address accuracy unmeasured.
components.next_action: Add per-field ROIs for KH ID front, 2-3x upscale + CLAHE variants with --psm 7 and voting; measure CER on 200 cards.
limitations: Low-confidence Khmer fields go to recapture/review, never PASS.

components.name: MRZ
components.evidence: TD1/TD2/TD3 parsing, all check digits, visual-zone comparison; dedicated MRZ OCR pass.
components.blocker: Real-card MRZ read rate unmeasured (1 of 2 real cards failed check digits).
components.next_action: Measure MRZ read rate on the labelled KH ID set; tune the MRZ band crop.

components.name: QR/Barcode
components.evidence: zxing decode, JWS/JSON/AAMVA/ICAO VDS parsing; signatures only against BARCODE_TRUST_STORE.
components.next_action: Decode the NSSF 'VERIFY gov.kh' QR on real cards and document what it contains.
limitations: A decoded QR never counts as authenticity without a trusted signature.

components.name: Document Authenticity
components.evidence: Authenticity accepted only from a verified chip or signed barcode; font, layout, text-region and pixel forensics are reported NOT_SUPPORTED; unverified documents go to REVIEW.
components.blocker: No forensic detectors for Cambodian cards, so KH ID/NSSF can never auto-PASS.
components.next_action: Decide the operating model: human review of authenticity, or an evaluated forensics vendor/model.
limitations: Every KH ID/NSSF session ends in MANUAL_REVIEW at best.

components.name: Portrait Extraction
components.evidence: Portrait located by face detection with DOCUMENT_PORTRAIT quality gate; unusable portraits trigger recapture.
components.blocker: Not measured on real cards.
components.next_action: Measure portrait detection rate on the labelled KH ID set.

components.name: Face Detection
components.evidence: OpenCV YuNet 2023mar with pinned hashes; selfie quality gate.
components.blocker: No real-device detection benchmark.
components.next_action: Measure detection and recapture rates on pilot selfies (Android + iPhone).

components.name: Face Match
components.evidence: SFace 2021dec 1:1 cosine; uncalibrated policy always REVIEW; calibration framework (FAR/FRR/TAR/AUC, distributions) added; production refuses to start without a measured report.
components.blocker: Face calibration missing.
components.next_action: Collect consented genuine/impostor pairs (100+ / 1000+ minimum) and run scripts/calibrate_face.py.
limitations: Face match uses the uploaded selfie; liveness frames are bound to it, but the best liveness frame is not yet the comparison source.

components.name: Liveness
components.evidence: Random single-use 4-step head-movement challenge, landmark geometry, replay and identity-continuity checks; uncalibrated policy is REVIEW at best; validation framework per attack type added.
components.blocker: Liveness not validated against presentation attacks.
components.next_action: Run printed-photo, phone-screen and video-replay attacks (20+ each) and 50+ genuine sessions; run scripts/calibrate_liveness.py.
limitations: 3D masks, AI-generated media and virtual-camera injection are NOT_SUPPORTED.

components.name: Android Mobile
components.evidence: Only the development web capture page and the Verix front-end prototype exist; no native app or mobile SDK.
components.blocker: No validated mobile capture.
components.next_action: Build the mobile web flow or SDK and test on 5+ Android models.

components.name: iPhone Mobile
components.evidence: As Android.
components.blocker: No validated mobile capture.
components.next_action: Test on 3+ iPhone models (Safari camera permissions).

components.name: QR Handoff
components.evidence: Single-session client tokens (kst_) exist; no desktop-to-phone QR handoff screen, claim-once or live status channel.
components.blocker: Spec QR handoff (QR_ALREADY_USED, MOBILE_SESSION_ALREADY_CLAIMED, desktop live status) not built.
components.next_action: Add a handoff token endpoint with single claim and a status stream.

components.name: NFC Android
components.evidence: Server verification exists; the chip reader is only scripts/nfc_simulator.py.
components.next_action: Keep NFC_ENABLED=false until a mobile reader is built and physically tested.

components.name: NFC iOS
components.evidence: As Android.
components.next_action: Keep NFC_ENABLED=false until physically tested.

components.name: CSCA
components.evidence: Trust store loads a CSCA folder and checks validity windows; no ICAO PKD/master-list import, update process or revocation (CRL) checking. Unknown issuers stay REVIEW.
components.next_action: Define the CSCA source and update process before enabling NFC.

components.name: Fraud
components.evidence: Duplicate/replay/velocity within the tenant, MRZ/barcode/chip mismatches, metadata markers; forensic detectors NOT_SUPPORTED and reported as such.
components.blocker: No screen/print reproduction (moire) detection.
components.next_action: Measure signal precision during the pilot; add screen-replay detection.

components.name: Risk Engine
components.evidence: Deterministic, versioned, tighten-only policy; FAIL > REVIEW > PASS; trace stored; uncalibrated face PASS now REVIEW; determinism test added.
components.blocker: Depends on calibrated inputs before any auto-PASS.
components.next_action: Pilot with 100% human review; compare reviewer and engine decisions.

components.name: Manual Review
components.evidence: Separate reviewer tokens, REVIEWER/AUDITOR roles, reason codes, optimistic concurrency (409 CASE_CHANGED), approval blockers, audited views; case now shows check results, summary and timeline.
components.blocker: Not used by real reviewers yet.
components.next_action: Run reviewer training on pilot cases.

components.name: RLS
components.evidence: Forced RLS on 25 tenant tables; live PostgreSQL isolation tests and scripts/security_check.py (24/24).
components.blocker: Not verified on the production Cloud SQL instance.
components.next_action: Run scripts/security_check.py against production before launch.

components.name: Encryption
components.evidence: AES-256-GCM per data class with separate keyrings and rotation; keys come from environment secrets.
components.blocker: No Cloud KMS; production key management unverified.
components.next_action: Move keyrings to Cloud KMS envelope encryption (Phase 19).

components.name: Webhooks
components.evidence: Transactional outbox, HMAC-SHA256 with timestamp, retries, SSRF re-check per delivery.
components.next_action: Test retries against a real receiver during the pilot.

components.name: Workers
components.evidence: SKIP LOCKED document worker and webhook worker; OCR is the capacity limit (~24 docs/min on a laptop).
components.next_action: Re-measure on Cloud Run sizes; add worker backlog metrics.

components.name: GCP
components.evidence: Phase 19 not started; Dockerfile exists but the image build was never verified.
components.blocker: No production deployment.
components.next_action: Build and scan the image; provision Cloud Run, Cloud SQL (private IP), GCS, KMS, Secret Manager.

components.name: Monitoring
components.evidence: Dependency health (/health/ready, /health/dependencies), Prometheus /metrics, alert rules (infra/monitoring).
components.blocker: Not connected to a monitoring system; queue/webhook backlog, KMS and certificate alerts missing.
components.next_action: Wire /metrics into Cloud Monitoring/Prometheus and route alerts to on-call.

components.name: Backup
components.evidence: No backup configuration in the repository.
components.blocker: Database backup not configured.
components.next_action: Enable Cloud SQL automated backups + PITR; define capture-bucket retention.

components.name: Restore
components.evidence: Restore never tested.
components.blocker: Restore never tested.
components.next_action: Run and document a timed restore drill.

components.name: Repository Data Hygiene
components.evidence: The public repository contains real identity-card photos (ID/KhmerID, ID/NSSF) and personal data fragments in BUILD_PROGRESS.md.
components.blocker: Real personal data is published in a public repository.
components.next_action: Make the repository private, remove the files and purge them from git history; keep test data outside the repo.
